dialogue.speaker: Sylvain
dialogue.text: Mercedes, you look divine as always. Off to pray?

dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: Hello, Sylvain. I was. How did you guess?

dialogue.speaker: Sylvain
dialogue.text: Because I have been admiring your lovely--

dialogue.speaker: Mercedes
dialogue.text: Oh. You are the type who is always looking at girls, aren't you?
